_note: Business-alias metadata used to seed ChromaDB semantic retrieval (scripts/setup_chromadb.py). Keys are normalized (upper, trimmed) column names taken from the reference sample the user provided. At setup time this is MERGED with the REAL live column list read from dbo.May_2 via INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS - columns present in the real table but missing here still get indexed with an auto-generated description, and aliases here for columns absent from the real table are simply skipped. Never assume the dummy sample is the ground truth schema.

BRANCH OFFICE CODE.description: Unique code identifying the branch office that issued the policy.

BRANCH NAME.description: Name of the branch office. Primary dimension for branch-wise / region-wise performance questions.

OFFICE NAME.description: Office name, generally mirrors BRANCH NAME.

STATE.description: State where the risk/vehicle is located. Used as a proxy for zone/region-wise questions if no explicit ZONE column exists in the live schema.

USGI BRANCH STATE.description: State of the servicing branch. Alternate zone/region proxy.

LINE OF BUSINESS.description: Insurance line of business (e.g. Motor, Health). Primary dimension for vertical-wise questions.

VERTICAL CHANNEL MAP.description: Mapped distribution vertical/channel classification (e.g. Retail Broker).

SUBVERTICAL CHANNEL.description: Sub-classification of the distribution channel (e.g. Broker, Agency, Bancassurance).

PRODUCT CODE.description: Unique code of the insurance product.

PRODUCT NAME.description: Name of the insurance product. Primary dimension for product-wise questions.

INTERMEDIARY.description: Name of the selling intermediary (broker/agent/bank). Used for intermediary performance ranking.

INTERMEDIARY CATEGORY.description: Category of intermediary, e.g. Retail Broker, Corporate Agent, Bancassurance.

BUSINESS TYPE FRESH RENEWAL.description: Whether the policy is Fresh (New), Renewal, or Roll Over business. Primary dimension for business-type-wise questions.

IND/CORP FLAG.description: Flags whether the policyholder is an Individual (I) or Corporate (C).

COMPANY SHORT DESCRIPTION.description: Short name of the underwriting insurance company.

BA NAME.description: Name of the business associate who sourced the policy.

PRIMARY SALES MANAGER NAME.description: Primary sales manager responsible for the business.

GROSS PREMIUM.description: Total gross premium booked. Primary measure for 'business'/'performance'/'sales' questions unless USGI-specific share is requested.

USGI GROSS PREMIUM.description: USGI's underwriting share of gross premium (co-insurance adjusted).

USGI NET PREMIUM.description: USGI's underwriting share of net premium.

TOTAL SUM INSURED.description: Total value of the risk covered by the policy.

COMMISSION AMOUNT.description: Commission paid out on the policy.

COMMISSION PER.description: Commission rate as a percentage of premium.

SHARE PERCENTAGE.description: Co-insurance share percentage held by USGI on the risk.

LIVE COUNT.description: Count of live/active policies - useful for volume-based (policy count) questions distinct from premium value.

TOTAL GST.description: Total GST charged on the policy.

BALANCE AMOUNT.description: Outstanding balance amount to be collected.

REFERENCE DATE.description: Date the transaction record was created. Primary date field for weekly/monthly trend questions if POLICY ISSUE DATE is unavailable.

POLICY ISSUE DATE.description: Date the policy was issued. Primary date dimension for trend-over-time questions.

VOUCHER DATE.description: Date the accounting voucher was raised.

BRANCH OFFICE CODE_TARGET_NOTE.description: No ACTUAL/TARGET columns exist in the reference sample. If the live dbo.May_2 schema contains columns such as TARGET_PREMIUM, BUDGET, PLAN_PREMIUM etc., the SQL agent should use them for actual-vs-target questions; otherwise it must clearly state that target data is not available in the current dataset instead of fabricating numbers.
